summary.tldr: Repeals a Canada Labour Code section that lets the Minister of Labour act to help settle industrial disputes.
what_it_does: Repeals section 107 of the Canada Labour Code.
Removes the Minister of Labour's power to take measures to promote settlement of an industrial dispute or difference.
Removes the Minister's power to refer a question to the Canada Industrial Relations Board or direct the Board to take any measure the Minister considers necessary.
summary.background: Section 107 of the Canada Labour Code is the part being repealed. It is the section that gives the Minister of Labour the powers described in the bill summary.
